comment: Garuda's helper in the Howling Eye (BNpcBase 1570, held by the director, which has it cast Feather Rain, 664: Eye of the Storm in Boss Mod's T03GarudaN). Its hit on whoever stands in its ring wasn't recorded: nobody did, in 32 casts in Bob's three Chronofoil captures of 2026-11-08 (the party stayed within 10.9 yalms of the middle). The guides call it heavy damage; 1061, Mistral Song's median to players, is a guess.
